observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a white sewing/embroidery machine sitting on a bed with striped bedding.
The machine's casing clearly reads "brother" in cursive logo on the front panel in both photos.
A blue side panel with an LCD screen and floral design is visible, consistent with a computerized embroidery machine.
No model number (e.g. 'SE630') is legible in either photo; the text is too small or not shown at the needed angle.
No power cord, foot pedal, embroidery hoop, or accessory kit is visible in either shot.
No photo shows the machine powered on, stitching, or threading indicators active.
A watermark 'ABIOLAONIMACHINE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlays both images, typical of marketplace reposts.

claims.claim: Seller's listing text: 'Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and Embroidery Machine'
claims.evidence: Brand logo 'brother' is visible in photo 0 and photo 1, but the specific model number SE630 is not legible in either photo.
Both photo 0 and photo 1 show a clear 'brother' logo on the machine body, not Singer.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or stitch correctly (motor, circuit board, or embroidery unit fault)
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the machine powered on, threading, and stitching a test pattern

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cord, foot pedal, embroidery hoops, bobbins) that are essential to use
risks.proof: A photo of the full accessory set laid out next to the machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Unconfirmed exact model (SE630 vs a lower-end Brother model) affecting value
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model number plate/label, usually on the back or base of the machine
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest plausible Brother embroidery-machine tier

risks.risk: Cosmetic or internal damage from informal home storage (on a bed, not a stable surface)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, bobbin case, and casing seams for cracks or wear
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible wear, no internal damage confirmed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model number plate/label on the machine
Video of the machine powering on and completing a stitch or embroidery pattern
Photo of all included accessories (cord, pedal, hoops, bobbins, manual)
Close-up of the needle plate and bobbin area for wear or damage
response.reason: The photos reliably show a Brother-branded computerized sewing/embroidery machine, which can be priced at its worst case (unverified function, no accessories shown) even though the exact model and working condition are unproven.
